bullets: Futures green: Nasdaq +0.6%, S&P +0.2%; Asia (Kospi +2.6%) and Europe (Stoxx 600 +0.5%) bounce on AI-earnings relief after last week's chip selloff.
Brent crude surged past $110 on Strait of Hormuz shipping attacks; 10-yr Treasury yield eased to ~5.09-5.11% from last week's 5.27% spike.
Tesla and Meta report Q3 results after today's close; Netflix fell 6.4% Tuesday on a mixed beat, showing the market is punishing any softness.
Last week's rout was macro-driven: hot wholesale inflation plus rising yields hit debt-funded AI infrastructure names; Supermicro's upbeat guidance today lifted server stocks.
